acceptance.given: Q2 is authoring the declared tests, helpers, fixtures, and oracles for Package A.

oracle.expected: The Q2 authoring check confirms changed paths are confined to the declared test modules, helper, and fixture tree; test cases bind the real validator entry or CLI; and an invalid oracle routes to contract repair before production changes.
forbidden: A test substitutes a mock product for the real production entry.
Production is changed before its allowed implementation stage to compensate for an invalid oracle.
An invalid oracle proceeds without contract repair.
oracle.observable: A scope and test-binding check inspects the Q2 changed-path manifest, test sources and oracle disposition during Q2 validation.

acceptance.then: The Q2 check reports whether the path allowlist, real-entry binding, and invalid-oracle repair boundary are satisfied.
acceptance.when: During Q2 scope and test-contract validation, inspect changed paths and test/oracle bindings before formal RED or production implementation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A repository-owned Q2 scope and test-binding check fails when production is changed during Q2, a mock replaces the real validator entry, or an invalid oracle proceeds without contract repair.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Q2 validation checks that authoring remains within the frozen test/helper/fixture allowlist, uses the real validator entry or CLI, and routes an invalid oracle to contract repair before production changes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes are authorized by this Q2 authoring-boundary obligation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Q2 authoring moves from declared test-support work to validated tests bound to the real production entry; an invalid oracle returns to contract repair, with production unchanged until its allowed stage.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Q2 path and binding check passes only when changed paths are within the frozen Q2 allowlist, tests bind the real validator entry or CLI, and invalid oracles are routed to contract repair before production changes.
